meta_description: Tvt Salvage LLC serving Abbeville - towing that shows up when you call.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: Abbeville, and the towns around it
quote_h2: Tell us what you need done
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers motorcycle transport, winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport. We work out of Abbeville and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Abbeville
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: Flatbed hauls a custom gray Dodge Challenger on big chrome wheels under a parking lot light at night
services.evidence: Flatbed hauls a black cruiser motorcycle strapped upright in a strip mall parking lot

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Flatbed with tilted bed loads a yellow convertible sports car at sunset on a rural road
services.evidence: Flatbed recovers a wrecked red GMC Yukon from a wooded roadside, driver visible in the cab

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Flatbed with amber lights flashing hauls a dark hatchback through a nighttime parking lot
services.evidence: Flatbed loaded with a black sedan parked under a gas station fuel canopy in Abbeville

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Flatbed with amber lights flashing hauls a dark hatchback through a nighttime parking lot

reviews.author: Carol Tschida
reviews.text: Tow truck driver (Mike Sanders) is highly skilled, courteous, thorough, and by far the best out there! Business owner (Calvin Gray) was responsive, fast, and extremely professional; he took time out of his personal schedule on a Sunday to come out and help his tow truck driver, and even sent an additional professional technician (Don Bombay) who was a tremendous help, to ensure safe loading and secure hook up of RV and hauled it from Abbeville to Augusta for a very reasonable price! TOP NOTCH BUSINESS!!

reviews.author: Mise En Place
reviews.text: Very prompt and dependable customer service. Highly recommend and the price for towing is very affordable.

reviews.author: Hannah Frost
reviews.text: Calvin is great at what he does. I have used him for towing my vehicles several times and will continue to use him. He always had a great attitude and does great business. Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Demetrius Hopkins
reviews.text: Phenomenal service and quick response! Calvin is not only a great businessman but he is also a great person.

reviews.author: Maggie Gilchrist
reviews.text: He was pleasant and thoughtful. Perfect towing job. Responds to messages quickly. I would use him again and highly recommend him

reviews.author: Jerica Jenkins
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the service I received! Driver was very nice and professional and so was Calvin. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jessica McIlwain
reviews.text: I had a flat tire early morning. Calvin made it to me quickly and had it changed in no time. Great attitude, friendly...definitely will call him again if needed!

reviews.author: Jason Mickel
reviews.text: As a Fleet Manager with over 300 vehicles, I run into some sticky situations in the middle of nowhere, and need to find the right people to help us out. I called 9 other companies in the Greenwood area, and Calvin was the only one willing to drive 90 minutes to pull us out of a mud bog and get us back on the road. We deliver oxygen and durable medical equipment to people in need, and during a weather-related crisis that had everyone in the area struggling, Calvin took care of us so we could take care of others. Would recommend to anyone in the area!

reviews.author: cindy hawkins
reviews.text: Needed help on a Sunday and called in early afternoon. Needed a large vehicle towed. He got it to me safely and always kept me updated throughout. He was professional but also personable. Enjoyable experience. I will use his service again!

reviews.author: Connie Carlson
reviews.text: After waiting 2 1/2 hours on a busy highway, numerous calls to local tire and towing companies, Time Value Towing came to our rescue in less than 15 minutes from a call for help. Calvin and Mike were professional, quick to help and very pleasant to deal with. I recommend them for any and all vehicle towing and tire repair help. Thank you.

reviews.author: Clarissa
reviews.text: He was extremely professional, prompt and skilled. I couldn’t get anyone to come unlock my car door, and had been waiting 8 hours for Allstate roadside service, I called Time Valued Towing & Transport LLC, and he arrived with 20 minutes and unlocked my car even quicker than that!

reviews.author: Shawn Migliore
reviews.text: My son had a car accident while out of state and his car was towed by Time Value. I can not say enough about this company. You will NOT go wrong trusting them with your car. The owner was nothing but kind and so helpful to us. He assisted in changing the tire and making sure we could drive the car safely 3 hours. If I could give more than 5 stars I would!!!!

reviews.author: Suzan Sessions
reviews.text: They did a great job. I had called a couple for tow companies and got a recording. When I called these guys not only did they answer the phone they could pick up my car within the hour. Super service from a very efficient and polite driver. I will use Time Valued Towing any tow job I may have in the future.

reviews.author: Latoya Bowie
reviews.text: Daughter locked the keys up in car this morning and Calvin came straight on and got me back into my vehicle. Service was great and price was reasonable. Will be doing business again with time-valued towing.

reviews.author: Sameia Brown
reviews.text: I had a flat and i needed my spare put on as soon as possible . his timing was good and the pricing was beyond reasonable since he went out of his way to get the pumper for my tire . best service ever and he cares about his business 10/10 experience!

reviews.author: Leigh Anne Etters
reviews.text: Very professional, fast, friendly service for a great price. Thank yall so much for the great experience in spite of our blown engine.

reviews.author: Evonna Jackson
reviews.text: Fantastic. Calvin commuted to GA to pick-up a vehicle for me. He was prompt, professional, and informative. It was a relief to find someone with he level of experience and willingness to get the job done. If you want a service done safely in a professional manner; I recommend hiring Calvin (you will be glad you did).

reviews.author: Bailey Johnson
reviews.text: Calvin was awesome! I was at work for a few hours on a Sunday and came out and my tired was flat!!! It used the roadside through my insurance and Calvin came out. He was dressed to the 9s so I felt kind of bad him having to get on the ground but he did and he was in and out within 30 minutes. Kind and courteous too.

reviews.author: Tyler Warhola
reviews.text: Great service. Needed a car towed to a dealership and they were able to get it done for me within a couple hours and for a great price. Will defiantly use them again when I need towing service.

reviews.author: James Richardson
reviews.text: TVT Towing is a great company. They were super fast and efficient. Kept me informed throughout the process and sent pictures confirming mission complete when done. Top notch indeed!

reviews.author: Lorraine Casanova
reviews.text: AMAZING SERVICE!!! Arrived in minutes and had incredible customer service skills AND ALOT CHEAPER than i expected for a long bed tow...cheap,fast,professional, and courteous service. Since I happen to hit curbs on a regular basis I will be using only this tow company in the future thank you highly recommended

reviews.author: Dajsha Perrin
reviews.text: We were in an impossible situation with our low car being stuck in mud and they came with confidence being able to pull us out. Sure enough with patience and experience they were able to get our car back on solid ground. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Jennifer Jones
reviews.text: Hands down the BEST experience I’ve had with a towing company. My poor little car was stuck in gravel….in my driveway. He got me out and made me laugh at little at the same time. This company is amazing 10/10 would recommend to anyone. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: ciara brown
reviews.text: Called multiple 24 hour places for a lockout service. Was turned down due to the time or the phone was never answered. I am glad that I gave Time Valued a call: fast, friendly, and professional. And I didn’t have to pay over a hundred dollars for the time of day. I’m saving this business in my phone.

reviews.author: Sommer Coen
reviews.text: Absolutely stellar customer service! Really rescued me when I was stranded late at night. I very much appreciate everything Calvin did to help me get off the side of the rd.

reviews.author: Taylor Danielle
reviews.text: Had my grandfather's truck towed from my parents home to my house. He took extreme care in my childhood memories and delivered more than promised and even listened to my recommendations when it came to the route we were taking. Five stars and recommend if anyone needs a professional to tow their vehicles!

reviews.author: Kamiyah Brown
reviews.text: I have experienced Time Value Towing services twice and every single time he was on-time and very professional! If I’m ever down on my luck again I know exactly who I’m calling and it’s Time Value Towing!!!!! You vehicle will be in good hands!

reviews.author: Danielle Ryan
reviews.text: A belt broke on my vehicle causing my car to cut off in the middle of the highway, in the pouring rain, and I had my 5 month old son with me. I called time value towing and they answered on the first ring. A tow truck was there in less than 20 minutes! I have NEVER had such a short wait for a tow truck. Pricing is exceptionally reasonable! I would highly recommend this company!!!!

reviews.author: Austin Rodgers
reviews.text: Excellent towing experience. On Thanksgiving Day, Calvin sacrificed his family time to make sure my vehicle was not stranded. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: paul spivey
reviews.text: Professional and Courteous service. I was locked out of my car at 2am. Calvin was there in less than an hour to really help me out. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: rick kelley
reviews.text: "Highly recommend Time Valued if you need quick, professional, personable service and the best quality is even in times if Covid and ever Rollercoaster of today's economy is the Time Values each tow service to each Family in need and you'll get the best price with the best first class service".

reviews.author: Pat Williams
reviews.text: TVT was great to deal with, they came to help when others wouldn’t. I will be recommending him to others.

reviews.author: Keri Gandee
reviews.text: When I was down and out with a flat tire and zero help . These folks stepped up and helped. I couldn't be more appreciative. I have been trying for 2 days to get someone to help . The pulled up quick . Thank you so very much !!

reviews.author: Rob Pruitt
reviews.text: He is very careful with loading and secured the truck down very well. He was quick and very reasonable with his price for towing on a Saturday night. I know who to call now!

reviews.author: Charles Tucker
reviews.text: I highly recommend this business. I received fast service on a Friday night at midnight to resolve a lockout issue. Every other option I tried resulted in nothing helpful, but when I called this place I got an immediate answer and help was on the way quickly.

reviews.author: davika94
reviews.text: I highly recommend using this business. He answered on the first ring and was there shortly after calling. Very professional and outgoing!! Will be using them for all future towing needs!

reviews.author: Polo Gray
reviews.text: Had Waited On Insurance company for An Hour .. Call This Gentlemen an He Was Their In 35 Min .. After A Short Talk .. We Was On Our Way !! Highly Recommended .. Keep Up The Great Service

reviews.author: Terri Lewis
reviews.text: The tow truck driver showed up in a timely manner and was very professional. He had a great personality and helped us laugh through a stressful situation.

reviews.author: Landon Z
reviews.text: Great experience! I got in my first accident and he was very patient with me and explained how the whole process would work. I would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Tyia Mohammed
reviews.text: Service was outstanding. He made sure that me an my children felt safe. Got me to my destination in a timely manner, very nice and outstanding

reviews.author: Austin Gandee
reviews.text: My boy pulled up and made sure out tire was changed and he did it out the kindness of his heart! Invest in your local companies people cuz good people do exist.

reviews.author: Syreeta Tinch
reviews.text: I appreciate Calvin. He came through for me. He let me know when he dropped my car off with a picture. Always professional.

reviews.author: Casey Bailey
reviews.text: It took this company six hours to get my vehicle and tow dollies home when in route. It was a 25 mile drive. When it did get here the tow dollies which were attached to my vehicle while being towed were mangled ? Destroyed and a total loss. Now thus company refuses to take responsibility for there negligence. The drive was clearly under the influence of something also.

reviews.author: larry hawkins
reviews.text: I would like to add that this service was exceptional. I truly can say he was professional and on time. I will continue to use this service in the future if need be for the service was extremely awesome.

reviews.author: Dwight Jackon
reviews.text: I will most definitely use the services of TVT Salvage again. Customer service and promptness is top notch. I was given a specific time they were gonna be here and they were.

reviews.author: Hakiim Speaks
reviews.text: Yes this is a Towing business that i will call wherever i may be .Mr.Calvin is a straight-foward guy whom understand situations at a car towing level,Thank you Mr.Calvin for your service.So if any of you out there give Mr.Calvin all call and he will save you.Peace

reviews.author: Kristina Bobo
reviews.text: Very professional and respectful! I work with a locating services and my truck was dead. By far was the best service I had provided by our fleet company.

reviews.author: Jesse Clary
reviews.text: Excellent service. Owner went above and beyond what is normally called to do by a driver. Thanks si much. Definitely would go pay extra in Abbeville just bc of thr fairness and to support this business5.

reviews.author: Matthew Wright
reviews.text: Hands down, fast service and towing. This company just picked up an F250 for my company to replace engine. I could not get to it in time, Time was fast. Choose them for your next tow.

reviews.author: Staci L.
reviews.text: I appreciate TvT, for their professionlism and being on time. Thank you so much for such great service.

reviews.author: Cheryl Bannister
reviews.text: My tire blew out as I was going to work. Calvin came by and asked if I needed help. He came back shortly with his rollback and carried my car to the shop. Thanks again for your help!

reviews.author: LaTessa Fossett
reviews.text: Very professional and fast. TVT will be my go to from now on and I'll also be sending my family and friends. Very satisfied with my experience.

reviews.author: Amya Amaker
reviews.text: This business is the best they help me out so much and I deeply appreciate y’all’s help! They are 24/7 and they are the sweetest people ever!

reviews.author: Ar'Monio Smith
reviews.text: Came very quickly! Very Professional, Nice, & Concerned! Loaded the Car in a careful & timely manner. Forever Grateful!

reviews.author: crystal wiggins
reviews.text: Very nice Man ! I asked him about something and he gave me a direct answer! He will be getting our business again.

reviews.author: Rhonda Winger
reviews.text: Great job on getting me into my vehicle in a timely manner, and very reasonable! Would Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Thomas Ouzts
reviews.text: Had a great experience dealing with tvt salvage LLC. They were very polite and the service was great.

reviews.author: Cory Beatty
reviews.text: Great guy , on time quick response . Highly recommend to anyone needing a tow . He is very reasonable and trustworthy

reviews.author: Maria Mills
reviews.text: TVT Salvage is the one to call. You can reach out to them and you will get a response. Friendly, reliability and affordable.

reviews.author: Mo'Neque Luchey
reviews.text: They were very professional and called with updates on their location. So glad they were able to help me!

reviews.author: Alex Cruickshanks
reviews.text: Unbelievable response time and outstanding customer service. Which made an unfortunate delay a little more bearable. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Tanner Kinard
reviews.text: Towed from Abbeville to Greenwood! Professional and a pleasure to work with! Day or night, rain or shine!

reviews.author: Kiara Devette
reviews.text: Calvin the right guy to get the job done!!!!! Call and he was in route on the way…,Excellent customer service

reviews.author: Jalen White
reviews.text: This was a wonderful experience and very conducive to me and my mother during this inopportune vicissitude.
